@graph.description: Canban is an open-source native macOS and Linux desktop workbench built in Rust that unifies Kanban cards for Human Context, GitHub Actions-style Workflows with isolated Git worktrees and FIFO Queue Merge, and Herdr persistent PTY terminals for native AI coding agent CLIs.
featureList: Kanban board for Human Context with Markdown specs, #Card links, screenshots, @Agent discussions, and GitHub Issue/PR sync
Visual Workflow Studio & YAML workflows with automatic per-Card Git worktree isolation
Serialized FIFO Queue Merge with automatic @merger conflict resolution
Herdr persistent PTY terminal powered by Rust, longbridge/nsh (AppKit/Metal on macOS, GTK4 on Linux), and libghostty-vt
Simultaneous multi-host canband connections over SSH or Tailscale alongside zero-interference Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (agy), and Cursor CLI support
